description: Generate a robust locator for an element described in plain words, e.g. "search box" or "the Add to Cart button of the Mechanical Keyboard". Matches text, label, placeholder, test id, element kind and the surrounding content; returns ready-to-paste locators for JavaScript, Python, Java, C# and Robot Framework. For elements in shadow DOM WebDriver cannot reach (Salesforce Lightning), the locators call a small helper file, returned once with the first such locator: save it next to the tests

elementDescription.description: Description of the element to find a locator for

name: browser_generate_locator
